source: If the problem statement contains ZXMATH0000XZ ZXMATH0001XZ score/probability intermediates,” think ZXNAME0000XZ. If it contains “fragmented per-request KV-cache allocation,” think PagedAttention.
zh: 如果问题陈述包含“ZXMATH0000XZ ZXMATH0001XZ 分数/概率中间值”，请考虑 ZXNAME0000XZ。如果它包含“分段的每个请求 KV 缓存分配”，请考虑 PagedAttention。
